newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hasbro Inc raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hasbro Inc raised.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co Inc raised its rating and estimates on shares of toy maker Hasbro Inc based on "a number of positive catalysts over the next two months."
-- In a statement, Jefferies said it raised the stock rating to buy from accumulate. It raised Hasbro's 1997 earnings estimate to $1.85/shr from $1.75 and its 1998 estimate to $2.05/shr from $1.90.

-- Two movies "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" and "Batman and Robin" could generate $400 million in 1997 sales for Hasbro. Also, the "Star Wars" toy license for the next trilogy of movies, starting in 1999, is expected to be awarded in June.
-- Jefferies also expects Hasbro to report "outstanding" second quarter earnings of $0.10/shr, up from $0.05/shr one year ago.

-- Jefferies said it "understands that the company is buying back shares at a more aggressive rate at current levels." Hasbro has a 5.0 million share repurchase program in place. Its stock was up 11/16 at 26-1/8 by midday.
-- The investment firm also said "Hasbro is working on a number of exciting projects for 1998" including the first products for movie studio, DreamWorks SKG.
